body:
### Device Vendor

QingPing

### Device Model

CGP22CLH

### Product Manual/Datasheet Link

https://downloads.rakwireless.com/IoT-Marketplace/Qingping/Indoor%20CO2%20Monitoring%20Solution/Qingping%20Indoor%20CO2%20Monitoring%20Solution%20User%20Manual.pdf

### LoRaWAN Class

Class A

### LoRaWAN Protocol Version

LORAWAN_1_0_3

### Uplink Data Examples

```text
Real-time example: 01 41 15 01 5C 77 88 B6 2F C2 9A 01 AA 4E 31 2E 30 2E 30 43 FE
Temperature = (764 - 500) / 10 = 26.4 C; humidity = 666 / 10 = 66.6%; CO2 = 426 ppm; battery = 78%.
History example with five records: 01 41 25 00 5C 77 88 B6 00 05 2F C2 9A 01 AA 4E 2F C2 9A 01 AA 4E 2F C2 9A 01 AA 4E 2F C2 9A 01 AA 4E 2F C2 9A 01 AA 4E 46 FE
Each six-byte record contains temperature/humidity, CO2, and battery.
```

### Decode Function (Optional)

```code
function Decoder(bytes, port) { var packed = (bytes[8] << 16) | (bytes[9] << 8) | bytes[10]; return { temperature: ((packed >> 12) - 500) / 10, humidity: (packed & 0xfff) / 10, co2: (bytes[11] << 8) | bytes[12], battery: bytes[13] }; }
```

### Downlink Support

No - uplink only

### BACnet Object Mapping Requirements

temperature-AnalogInputObject
humidity-AnalogInputObject
co2Value-AnalogInputObject
battery-AnalogInputObject
